about: How Objects stand on one another (R144): the kernel works each Object out from its own parameters; what follows from another Object is said here and the Studio writes it, after every step, in the same step. A template's relationships replace one by id, add new ones, or take one out with off: true; a project's overrides.relationships the same; a firm's own copy of this file wins in its work. A rule: for (a kind, or a behaviour its Object has), only (auto: what the model defaults own, the default; all: every one), when (a formula), set (parameters by formulas of storey, rise, slab_above, beam_on and the Object's own parameters), or opens: above (its plan outline drawn as an opening in the slab on the level above, once).
